description.text: The third Diamond & Pearl set, released in November 2007 with 132 cards and two theme decks, Lavaflow and Powerhouse. It brought in Sinnoh's Pokémon with alternate forms and more Pokémon holding items, now evolution items such as the Dusk Stone, with which Murkrow can evolve into Honchkrow on any turn. It has only two Pokémon LV.X, Gardevoir and Honchkrow, the fewest of any set since they began: the Japanese set's Dialga, Palkia and Darkrai were held back to come out in English with the film The Rise of Darkrai.
